# ECN-2026-006 Change notice - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-IH03

Reason for change

Background: During routine thermal performance trending and maintenance inspections it was observed that coil surface temperatures and dielectric insulation condition on Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 were degrading at a rate higher than expected. Review of historical maintenance records and comparison to similar assets indicated that periods of marginal cooling water flow correlated with accelerated coil wear and reduced heater efficiency. A recent engineering assessment recommended establishing a formal minimum coil cooling water flow requirement to reduce thermal stress, mitigate premature coil failure, and stabilize process performance.

Change rationale: Establishing a documented minimum coil cooling water flow for EQ-P3-L1-IH03 reduces risk of coil overheating, insulation breakdown, and unplanned downtime. The minimum flow requirement provides a clear threshold for operational monitoring, maintenance acceptance criteria, and SOP alignment. This ECN implements that threshold and updates affected procedures and records to ensure consistent compliance and traceability. This change aligns with findings and actions described in related review ECN-2026-027 and requires updates to SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-03 to reflect new acceptance criteria and monitoring steps.

Affected items

Primary asset: EQ-P3-L1-IH03 (Hot Forge induction billet heater #3) — coil assembly, cooling water inlet and return piping, flow monitoring points, and associated instrumentation used to verify cooling performance.

Procedures: SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-03 require revision to incorporate the new minimum coil cooling water flow threshold, criteria for action when flow is below threshold, verification steps for corrective actions, and recordkeeping requirements.

Documentation and records: Operational logs, preventive maintenance checklists, calibration records for flow-measuring instruments, and incident reports where coil cooling was implicated in degraded performance shall reference this ECN and include the measured flow values against the established threshold.

Suppliers and spare parts: Any orders or acceptance criteria for coil assemblies or flow control devices used on EQ-P3-L1-IH03 shall include reference to this ECN and the minimum flow requirement to ensure compatibility and verification at installation.

Implementation

Specification: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min. This value shall be used as the operational acceptance threshold for normal production and for return-to-service after maintenance.

Operational verification: Operators shall verify coil cooling water flow at the designated measurement point for EQ-P3-L1-IH03 during startup, shift checks, and after any cooling system intervention. If measured flow is below the specified minimum, the heater shall be taken to a safe state as defined in SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-03 and maintenance shall be notified.

Maintenance actions: Maintenance shall inspect inlet strainers, valves, piping, heat exchangers, and flow-sensing instrumentation when flow is found to be below the specified minimum. Corrective actions include cleaning, valve adjustment to remove unintended throttling, repair of leaking joints, and verification of pump performance per existing maintenance practice. After corrective action, the flow measurement shall be repeated and recorded prior to returning EQ-P3-L1-IH03 to service.

Instrumentation and calibration: Existing flow-measuring devices used to verify coil cooling water flow for EQ-P3-L1-IH03 must be within their calibration cycle and proven accurate for the range around the established minimum. If existing instrumentation cannot reliably resolve the specified minimum, replacement or supplemental verification methods shall be implemented. Calibration records shall be attached to the maintenance record for the action.

Procedure updates: Revise SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-03 to include:
- The specified coil cooling water flow minimum.
- Stepwise actions for operators and maintenance when flow is below the threshold.
- Forms and log entries required to document flow measurements, corrective actions, and approval to return to service.
- Roles and responsibilities for confirming the flow meets the minimum after corrective work.

Examples of application: If an operator observes reduced heating efficiency on EQ-P3-L1-IH03, the operator follows SOP-P3-L1-01 to measure coil cooling water flow. If the recorded flow is below the specified minimum, the operator initiates the response sequence in SOP-P3-L1-03, places the heater in a safe state, and notifies maintenance. Maintenance records the observed flow, corrective steps taken, calibration status of the measuring device, and final measured flow upon restoration. These entries are retained in the maintenance log and referenced for trending.

Records to keep

- Operational flow check entries for EQ-P3-L1-IH03 with the measured value and the action taken when below the specified minimum.  
- Preventive maintenance reports documenting inspections related to coil cooling and any corrective interventions performed.  
- Calibration certificates or verification records for flow-measuring devices used for compliance checks.  
- ECN trace file linking maintenance and operations records to this ECN and to related ECN-2026-027.  
- Revised procedure versions for SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-03 with visible change markers and an index entry referencing this ECN.

Approvals

Engineering: review and acceptance of the technical basis for the specified minimum flow and verification that implementation steps are consistent with safe operation and design margins.

Maintenance: acceptance of revised maintenance actions, confirmation of capability to verify and restore coil cooling flow to the specified minimum, and commitment to update maintenance checklists and records.

Operations: acknowledgement of procedural updates, training plan to ensure operators can measure and respond to low flow conditions per SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-03, and confirmation of incorporation into shift handover practices.

Quality and Plant Management: final approval for change implementation at P3, line P3-L1, and confirmation that records will be maintained in the document control system and referenced in future audits. All approvals shall be recorded in the ECN approval form and retained with the ECN file.

Related documents

- ECN-2026-027  
- SOP-P3-L1-01  
- SOP-P3-L1-03

End of document.
